caption: The drawing depicts a dress with a fitted bodice and a full skirt, designed with a wide, slightly squared neckline and elbow-length sleeves. The dress is primarily colored in varying shades of pink and red, accented with thin vertical stripes in yellow and blue. Small floral motifs, mostly white with hints of other colors, are distributed throughout the dress fabric. The bodice is structured with visible seam lines, and the skirt extends outward with pleats, giving it volume. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are no additional objects or features present in the drawing. The dress is shown without a body; instead, the neckline area is colored in a light beige tone to suggest where a head and neck would be.
title: Child's Dress
